purpose: Reconcile two peer sources of invoice data to identify missing invoices on either side and amount differences for records present in both files.

sources.expected_characteristics: comma-delimited text file containing invoice records with external supplier statement data
comma-delimited text file containing ledger tracking records with internal payment status

business_rules.description: No authoritative source; both files treated as peers for comparison.
Match records using InvoiceNumber only; do not translate or normalize status values (PAID/UNPAID vs CLEARED/PENDING).

matching_or_processing_rules.description: Join on InvoiceNumber field exactly as written in both sources.
Compare Amount field as numeric values for differences; preserve source status values as contextual metadata without normalization.

missing_in_source_A: InvoiceNumber not present in supplier-statement.txt but in ledger-book.txt
With corresponding SupplierName, Date, Amount, and status context
missing_in_source_B: ReferenceNumber (ledger) or InvoiceNumber not present in ledger-book.txt but in supplier-statement.txt
With corresponding SupplierName, Amount, Currency, and status context
amount_differences: For invoices present in both files: numeric difference between source_A.Amount and source_B.Amount

destination: Review-only output; no external write authority granted.

requested_delivery.format: JSON artifact plus human-readable discrepancy report
requested_delivery.authority_status: non-authoritative proposal for Learning Lab validation

human_confirmations.question: Which file should be treated as source-of-truth for matching?
human_confirmations.answer_provided: Neither; both files are peer sources. Report what is missing from either side and differences in compared fields.

human_confirmations.question: How to handle the difference in status values (PAID/UNPAID vs CLEARED/PENDING)?
human_confirmations.answer_provided: Do not translate or normalize status values. Compare Amount only; preserve status as context if useful but do not treat as executable rule.

human_confirmations.question: What output format is desired for the process definition?
human_confirmations.answer_provided: JSON artifact showing discrepancy report: invoices missing from either side, amount differences for matches.

open_questions.question: Should the Notes field in ledger-book.txt be considered when evaluating discrepancies or marking records as exceptions?
Both files show Currency=GBP but what if different suppliers use different currencies? Should currency match be part of the reconciliation rule?

evidence_notes.observed_content: Header: Date, Supplier Name, InvoiceNumber, Amount, Currency, Status followed by 6 data rows for Acme Corp (ACC-INV-001, ACC-INV-002), Beta Supplies Ltd (BSI-2047, BSI-2048), Gamma Traders Co (GTC-3011), and Delta Systems Inc (DSI-4002).

Header: Date, ReferenceNumber, SupplierName, InvoiceNumber, Amount, Status, Notes followed by 6 data rows with LDR-001 to LDR-006 referencing the same invoices, with CLEARED/PENDING status and Verified match or Payment not yet received notes.
